# VetCrewGames — Casual Web Games & Mini-Games Portal

> Free web gaming collection and casual mini-games portal by VetCrew. Play lightweight, accessible games directly in the browser across desktop and mobile devices.

## Main Pages

- [Game Portal Home](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/): Browse the full catalog of playable mini-games, high score leaderboards, and achievements.
- [English Version](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/en/): English catalog and interface.
- [Deutsche Version](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/de/): Deutsche Spielesammlung.
- [Nederlandse Versie](https://alik532ua.github.io/VetCrewGames/nl/): Nederlandse spelcollectie.

## Key Features

- Browser-first Instant Play: No downloads, installations, or app store requirements.
- Responsive & Touch-friendly: Optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop gameplay.
- Multilingual Support: Ukrainian, English, German, and Dutch localized interfaces.
- Offline Capability: Playable offline via Progressive Web App (PWA) caching.
- Accessibility: Full keyboard navigation, customizable themes, and sound settings.

## Technical Details

- Built with SvelteKit 2 and Svelte 5 runes.
- Fully static prerendered HTML with zero latency start.
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/LLMO) & Schema.org JSON-LD WebApplication schema.

- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Alik532UA/VetCrewGames
